applies_why: The judge text treats the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity as a reason to mark D6 vs C4 UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: The phrase single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED: one reading forbids using Romans 1:3's silence on paternity as an UNDERDETERMINED ground; the other reading permits it because the judge cites multiple rounds. The first reading applies.
why: The judge makes lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity the ground for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the forbidden use of a verse not stating a link or its contrary.
